description:
A small clipboard history manager

ClipX records clipboard history so you can restore and paste previously copied text, images, files, and other clipboard formats. Optional plugins extend its functionality.
- Added an option to hide clipboard windows from screenshots, screen recording, and screen sharing.
- Changed the default secondary paste hotkey for new installations to Ctrl+Shift+Insert, preserving existing hotkeys.
- Plain-text pasting now formats file clipboards as comma-separated full paths, quoting paths containing spaces or commas.
- Made subsequent in-app updates install silently.
- Fixed foreground activation of plugin installation prompts.
